start.text: Greetings, traveler. I see the celestial light pulsing within your right eye... Can it truly be? The living spark of the First Eye walking among mortals?

choices.text: What is this place, Lorekeeper?
I seek the Elemental Stones of the Five Gods.
I have recovered the Ancient Fire Fragment!
I must take my leave.

explain_shrine.text: You stand upon the Dais of the Shattered Eye. Ignareth willingly shattered the celestial lens out of pure divine love, protecting mortals from being blinded by holy light.
explain_shrine.lieReason: [Eye Vision Pierces Deceit]: Ignareth did not shatter the eye out of love; the gods tore the First Eye apart in a desperate panic when they realized their shared lifeforce was bleeding away.

choices.text: Tell me about your clan, the Embercrest.
[Eye Vision] You speak of holy sacrifice, yet your words ring hollow, Elara.
Is there any way I can help prove my goodwill?
I see. Let us speak of other matters.

confront_lie.text: You... you see past the sacred liturgy? By the ash... The priests of the Order swore that the congregation would never discover the truth. The gods were dying, traveler. They are dying still.

choices.text: Why hide the truth from your people?
Tell me of the missing fire shard.

explain_embercrest.text: We revere Ignareth the Burning Mother. Her flame cleanses and tempers the soul, like fine steel in the forge.

choices.text: Passion and cleansing flame are worthy virtues.

mention_stones.text: One of the shards—the Stone of Pyres—rests deep in the Caldera, but an ancient fragment broke off near the Arch.

choices.text: I will retrieve the fragment for you.

offer_quest.text: Near the northern Archway, an ancient shard of the Stone of Pyres hums with fading heat. If you bring it to me, I shall grant you a sacred relic.

choices.text: I accept the task.

turn_in_quest.text: By Ignareth's mercy! The shard warms my hands as if plucked from the First Eye itself. Take this Amulet of Cinderfall. Seek Warmaster Varek in Cinderfall Village to the north!

choices.text: I will seek out Cinderfall.

start.text: Halt, wanderer! You step into Cinderfall with a celestial glow in your brow. We of the flame do not bow to hollow omens. State your business in our highlands!

choices.text: I seek an audience with the Burning Mother.
I come to unite the five clans before war destroys us all.
I stand with Embercrest. Your strength in battle is legendary.
I have spoken with High Priestess Pyra as you commanded.
Farewell, Chieftain.

audience_plea.text: An audience? The Caldera is barred to all save those who prove their marrow. Even our smiths must forge their own keys before the temple gates part. Seek Forgemaster Kael at the village forge, and Pyra at the Great Pyre.

choices.text: I will earn my passage.

unity_plea.text: Unity? The Tidewrought drown our caravans and the Stonebound barricade their mountain passes! Only flame has the purity to cut through this stagnation.

choices.text: Violence will leave all five clans in ashes, Varek.
Let me prove my worth through action, not words.

praise_strength.text: Ha! At least your tongue carries the heat of truth. The weak perish in our mountain frosts; only the resolute endure. Speak with Pyra and Kael.

choices.text: I shall do so immediately.

complete_welcome.text: Pyra gave you her holy ash mark? Then you have our formal greeting, wanderer. Take this piece of raw Igneous Ore. Forgemaster Kael will need it if you hope to smelt the key to the Temple.

choices.text: Thank you, Chieftain.

start.text: Mind the sparks, stranger! This anvil has shaped fifty thousand blades for the clan war. What brings you to my crucible?

choices.text: Chieftain Varek said you can forge the Obsidian Sun Key.
I have solved the Crucible puzzle!
How do you manage to work near this intense heat?
Just looking around.

explain_key.text: Aye, the Sun Key. The Caldera lock will only accept obsidian forged at three sacred thresholds: First, blast the draft with the bellows (3). Next, stoke the igneous coal (2). Finally, quench in cold flux (1). Step up to the forge console and dial the registers in that order!

choices.text: I will configure the furnace registers.

turn_in_forge.text: By the Burning Mother's hammer! You balanced the registers perfectly. Look at this golden luster—the Obsidian Sun Key is complete! Take it. Next, seek Pyra for the beasts' trial.

choices.text: Thank you, Forgemaster.

forge_lore.text: The secret isn't enduring the heat—it's becoming the heat. A blacksmith who fears burns should stick to weaving wool.

choices.text: A true master of the craft.

start.text: The sacred pyre hungers for devotion. I sense an ancient, divine fragment burning behind your iris, traveler. Why do you stand before the altar?

choices.text: I seek your blessing, Priestess.
Tell me of the sacred beasts: the Phoenix and the Lion.
Is it true the sacred pyres never need relighting?
I have communed with the Lion and the Phoenix!
May the flame guide you.

give_blessing.text: Kneel and receive the cinder mark upon your forehead. May Ignareth's solar gaze incinerate your doubts! Inform Chieftain Varek that the pyre welcomes you.

choices.text: I receive the mark with reverence.

explain_beasts.text: The Fire Lion roars from the Pride Crags to the west, challenging all who lack resolve. Above him roosts the Phoenix upon Solar Aerie. Commune with both to prove you walk the path of kings.

choices.text: I shall journey to the crags.

test_lie.text: The Holy Pyre has burned for five hundred years without a single cinder dying. Ignareth's power is infinite and eternal.
test_lie.lieReason: [Eye Vision Pierces Deceit]: Pyra secretly adds ground cinder-pitch every midnight; she has had visions of the sacred fire turning to cold ash within her lifetime.

choices.text: [Eye Vision] You add pitch every midnight, Pyra. You know the divine fire is fading.
A testament to the goddess's might.

confront_pyra_lie.text: Hush! Speak not such blasphemies where the warriors can hear! If the clan knew the divine hearth was cooling, despair would snuff us out before our enemies do. Go... seek the beasts. Perhaps they still remember how to rekindle the sun.

choices.text: I will uncover the truth for all of us.

turn_in_beasts.text: The Phoenix gifted you an eternal feather, and the Lion yielded his talisman! You truly are the harbinger foretold. Beyond the village lies the Molten Chasm—speak to Morvath on the edge.

choices.text: Onward to the Caldera.

start.text: Ah, another pilgrim marching toward the boiling crater. Tell me, do you plan to drown in magma, or are you wiser than the zealots in the village?

choices.text: How does one cross the Molten Chasm safely?
Why are you camped out here in exile?
I have crossed the Molten Chasm!
Keep your cynicism to yourself, Morvath.

explain_chasm.text: The lava will melt your boots in three seconds flat. But the ancient architects weren't savages—they built a path of submerged obsidian pedestals. Normal eyes can't see through the thermal glare. But that magic eye of yours? Activate Eye Vision [V], and the stepping stones will glow right before your feet!

choices.text: I will activate Eye Vision to cross.

turn_in_crossing.text: You actually did it! You crossed the boiling river using the hidden sight. The Temple of the Sacred Pyre lies straight ahead. You'll need to solve the Sun Refraction Prisms to open the gate.

choices.text: Thank you for the guidance, Morvath.

explain_exile.text: I read texts from the other four clans. When you realize the Tidewrought and Stonebound have identical claims of divine favoritism, you begin to question who started this farce.

choices.text: Questioning blind doctrine is true wisdom.
Doubt is the luxury of cowards.

start.text: Whoa! Your eye looks like a glowing blue sun! Are you a wizard from the floating cliffs?

choices.text: No, little one, but I seek the sacred Phoenix.
Don't play so close to the lava vents, Tula.
Run along home to your parents.

phoenix_folklore.text: My grandad says the Phoenix loves shiny things! If you bow when you reach the high roost, she won't peck your head off. She shed a glowing feather up there yesterday!

choices.text: Thanks for the tip, Tula!

child_warning.text: I'm not scared! Ignareth's fire only burns bad people, that's what Priestess Pyra says! ...Though my cousin singed his eyebrows last week.

choices.text: Stay safe, little one.

start.text: MORTAL BEARER OF THE FIRST EYE... You have braved the furnace of Cinderfall, crossed the boiling chasm, and solved the solar prisms. At last, the living fragment stands before my dying flame.

choices.text: Dying flame? Then the rumors are true—the gods are fading!
I kneel before you, Burning Mother. Take my eye and reignite your glory!
I came for the Stone of Pyres. Aethrava must be unified.

truth_revealed.text: We were never five gods, Kaelen. We are five wounds on a single celestial heart. When the Order of the Open Eye severed us, they damned us to bleed out across centuries of petty tribal war. My fire cannot burn much longer.

choices.text: Then give me your Stone. I will heal the shattered being.
If you are dying, the clans must prepare to stand alone.

pledge_allegiance.text: Your loyalty is fierce as untamed wild-fire. Yet a blind flame only consumes itself. Take my stone, Kaelen, and burn away the lies that choke our world.

choices.text: I accept the sacred burden.

demand_stone.text: Bold words before a living inferno. Yet perhaps boldness is what this fractured realm needs. Take the Stone of Pyres—and remember that fire both creates and destroys.

choices.text: I will wield it with wisdom.

bestow_stone.text: TAKE THE STONE OF PYRES! Let the first elemental shard find its home within your grimoire. Seek now the drown-ruins of the Tidewrought, where Nerivael sleeps in forgetting depths!

choices.text: I claim the Fire Stone!

start.text: Heave to, traveler! Watch your step on these barnacle-slick docks. The currents off Thalassport can swallow a galleon in two swells. What business brings an eye-bearer to our coast?

choices.text: I seek an audience with Nerivael the Deep Mind.
I heard rumors of smuggler syndicates operating in the cove.
I have spoken with Sea-Seer Vael as you directed.
I reported Corvo's contraband ring to your harbor guard.
Just taking in the salt air, Captain.

audience_plea.text: An audience with the Deep Mind? Ha! The Sunken Sanctuary is sealed beneath forty fathoms of tide. The only way in is through the ancient flooded archives, and the sluice gates are jammed tight with silt. Seek out Scholar Sylas and Sea-Seer Vael near the tide pools.

choices.text: I will seek them out immediately.

smuggler_inquiry.text: Aye, Corvo and his bilge-rats are looting relics from the pre-flood domes and selling them to foreign black markets. If you catch him trafficking temple artifacts, bring him to justice!

choices.text: I will keep my eyes open.

complete_arrival.text: Vael read your tide-lines? Then the sea recognizes your step, wanderer. Take this Coral-Encrusted Astrolabe. Scholar Sylas needs it to decipher the ancient sluice mechanism.

choices.text: Thank you, Captain Marina.

report_corvo_reward.text: By the Great Whale's wake! You caught Corvo red-handed and recovered the temple pearl? You have done Thalassport a grand service, traveler. The fleet owes you a debt of honor!

choices.text: The rule of the sea must be respected.

start.text: Careful with that parchment! Salt damp is the greatest destroyer of pre-flood civilization. What discoveries have you dredged from the surf, wanderer?

choices.text: I have the Coral Astrolabe from Captain Marina.
I have operated the Sluice Valves and lowered the tide!
Tell me of the Drowned Causeway ahead.
I must be going.

receive_astrolabe.text: Astounding! The gear ratios on this astrolabe show the exact tidal alignment needed to operate the harbor sluice gates! Listen carefully: First, open the Sea-Surge Valve (1). Second, shut the Mud-Gate (2). Third, engage the Lower Weir Drain (3). Turn the valves at the dam in that exact order!

choices.text: I will configure the sluice valves.

complete_sluice.text: Look! The tide drains away from the lower basin! The Drowned Causeway is revealed! Yet take care—the deep water between the stone arches is perilous. Seek the sacred beasts before you cross.

choices.text: Thank you, Scholar Sylas.

explain_causeway.text: It was built before the First Eye shattered. When the waters rose, the central arches collapsed underwater. Normal mortals see only churning deep surf. But if you have the legendary sight, the submerged coral spans become visible!

choices.text: My Eye Vision will find the path.

start.text: Listen... do you hear the oceanic thrum beneath the shale? The tides carry forgotten names from five hundred leagues away. Why do you disturb the surface waters?

choices.text: Captain Marina sent me to seek your counsel.
Tell me of the Sacred Whale and the Great Serpent.
Is it true Nerivael watches over all oceans in serene omniscience?
I have communed with both sacred beasts!
Peace to your meditations, Seer.

give_guidance.text: A spark of celestial luminescence walks the coast. The Deep Mind stirs when you approach the tide pools. Inform Marina that the currents favor your entry.

choices.text: I thank you, Sea-Seer.

explain_beasts.text: The Sacred Whale surfaces at Whale Song Shoals to the east, carrying the acoustic memories of the abyss. To the north-west, in Serpent's Trench, coils the Great Sea Serpent, guardian of the tidal thresholds. Receive their tokens to prove you carry no poison in your soul.

choices.text: I shall journey to both shoals.

test_lie.text: Nerivael rests in perfect oceanic tranquility. Not a single current shifts without the Deep Mind's loving design.
test_lie.lieReason: [Eye Vision Pierces Deceit]: Vael knows Nerivael is drowning in panic; the sea god's consciousness is dissolving and fragmenting with every passing century.

choices.text: [Eye Vision] You lie, Vael. Nerivael is not tranquil—the deep mind is dissolving in terror.
A comforting thought in turbulent times.

confront_vael_lie.text: Silence! Do you wish to cause mass hysteria in the fleet? Every night I hear the whale song turning to discordant cries! The god is forgetting who he is! Go... seek Corvo in the cove. He dredged a pearl from the sanctuary that might pierce the deep veil.

choices.text: I will uncover the truth for all who walk the shores.

complete_beasts.text: The Whale gifted you abyssal ambergris, and the Serpent yielded an emerald scale! You are consecrated by the tide. Now seek Corvo in the smuggler's cove—he holds the final key to the sanctuary.

choices.text: I will confront Corvo.

start.text: Keep your voice down, mate! You want Marina's marines swarming down here? I see what you're after—you need the Luminescent Tidal Pearl to unseal the temple vault, don't you?

choices.text: Give me the temple pearl, Corvo.
What are you doing hidden in this sea-cave?
I'll let you be.

explain_trade.text: Salvage, mate. Pure salvage! The fleet calls it smuggling because they didn't get their cut. If an empire drowned five hundred years ago, its treasure belongs to whoever has the lungs to dive for it.

choices.text: A convenient moral philosophy.

the_bargain.text: Here's the deal: I fished this pearl from the submerged library vault. It's yours, free and clear—on ONE condition. Marina's patrol is searching the beach. You swear to misdirect her hounds away from my contraband cache. Deal?

choices.text: [Moral Choice] Deal. I will misdirect Marina. Hand over the pearl.
[Moral Choice] No deal, Corvo. Surrender the sacred relic or I call the harbor marines right now!

accept_smuggler.text: Smart traveler! Here is the Luminescent Tidal Pearl. Remember our pact: you saw nothing down in this cove! Now go cross the Drowned Causeway before the tide comes rushing back.

choices.text: A deal is a deal.

reject_smuggler.text: Curse you and your righteous glare! Fine, take the blasted pearl! But you just made an enemy of every smuggler from here to the Sunken Fjord. Get out of my sight!

choices.text: The sanctuary is sacred, Corvo.

start.text: Gaze into the tide pools, wanderer. Notice how the anemones open and close with the rhythm of the moon? Life in Thalassport moves to water, not fire or iron.

choices.text: How do I safely approach the Great Serpent?
What do the coastal folk think of the Embercrest fire clan?
Farewell, Tidecaller.

serpent_advice.text: The Serpent of the Trench hates sudden movements. Walk slowly across the tidal rocks and do not draw steel. If you show no hunger for violence, the serpent will grant you its emerald scale.

choices.text: Thank you for the wisdom.

fire_clan_opinion.text: Embercrest burns everything it touches until only soot remains. They think they are strong, but steam always rises above flame. One day, the oceans will swallow their volcanoes.

choices.text: A grim prophecy.

start.text: WHO CALLS FROM THE SURFACE OF MEMORY? ...The First Eye pulses once more in mortal bone. For five centuries, my thoughts have washed across the abyss like sand slipping through fingers.

choices.text: Nerivael, I have crossed the drowned ruins to retrieve the Water Stone.
Ignareth spoke of the gods dying. Is your memory truly unraveling?
I come in reverence, Deep Mind. Let the tides wash away mortal grief.

truth_revealed.text: Ignareth spoke truth through her ashes... We are the scattered fragments of a slain celestial whole. With each century, I forget forty languages, three constellations, and the faces of my divine kin. Soon, only cold empty water will remain.

choices.text: Then bestow your stone upon me. I will rebind the fractured truths.
Perhaps forgetting is mercy for a world torn by war.

plea_stone.text: The Stone of Abyssal Depth... You seek to hold the weight of five hundred leagues of ocean memory? It will crush any soul that lacks the resolve to look past mortal illusions.

choices.text: My Eye has seen through the lies of both clans. I am ready.

reverence_plea.text: Your humility is a gentle tide in a tempest of mortal pride. Take this fragment, Kaelen, and let its cold depths balance the raging inferno of Ignareth's fire.

choices.text: I receive the Water Stone with solemn honor.

bestow_stone.text: TAKE THE STONE OF ABYSSAL DEPTH! Feel the tides of antiquity surge through your veins! The Fire and Water shards now sing in harmony. Walk forward, Kaelen—the earth itself awaits your footstep in the Stonebound Peaks!

choices.text: I claim the Water Stone!
